title: Putin Has Shown No Willingness To End Ukraine War, Says Mike Pompeo
content: Former US Secretary of State Mike Pompeo tells RFE/RL that Vladimir Putin has shown no willingness to end the war in Ukraine and warns of growing cooperation between Russia, China, Iran, and North Korea. He also discusses prospects for peace and the risks of negotiating with Moscow.

title: Moldovan President Calls Security Meeting After Massive Data Breach

title: Russian Drone Strikes Railway Station In Dnipro, Killing At Least 14
content: A Russian drone struck a railway station in Dnipro, killing at least 14 people and injuring others, Ukrainian officials said. The attack hit a platform where a passenger train bound for Zaporizhzhya was standing.

title: The Week In Russia: Tensions, Talks, And 'Terror'

title: 'Life On Every Street': Ukrainians In Kherson Welcome Cease-Fire In Nearby Oleshky
content: A US-brokered cease-fire went into effect on October 27 to let aid arrive in the Russian-occupied suburb of Oleshky and allow civilians to leave. On the opposite side of the Dnieper River, in the Ukrainian-held city of Kherson, locals said the pause in fighting produced a rare sense of normalcy.

title: 'Get Killed Or Starve': Life Under Russian Occupation In Oleshky
